title: Grafana or Kibana: Dashboards Across Many Sources vs Deep Log Search
excerpt: Grafana visualises data from many different backends; Kibana is the interface for the Elastic Stack. Which one fits depends on where your data lives and what you do with it.
verdict: Grafana is the better choice for unified dashboards and alerting across many data sources such as Prometheus, SQL databases and cloud monitoring. Kibana is stronger when your data is already in Elasticsearch and full-text log search is central to the job.
